English: Extrinsic environmental factors influence the spatio-temporal dynamics of many organisms, including insects that transmit the pathogens responsible for vector-borne diseases (VBDs).
Luganda: Ensonga eziri ebweru w’obutonde bw’ensi zisalawo enneeyisa y’ebiramu eby’enjawulo mu bifo n’obudde obw’enjawulo, omuli ebiwuka ebitambuza obuwuka obuleeta obulwadde (VBDs).
Yoruba: Àwọn ohun ajẹmọ́ta tí ó ń nípa lórí ọwọ́jà ati àkókò-ìtànkálẹ̀ ọ̀pọ̀ ohun-abẹ̀mí, tí ó fi mọ́ àwọn kòkòrò tí ó tan àwọn afàìsàn tí wọ́n ń fa àwọn àrùn ìgénijẹ́ (VBD) ká.
Zulu: Izici zemvelo zangaphandle zinethonya ku-spatio-temporal dynamics yezinto eziningi eziphilayo, kuhlanganise nezinambuzane ezisakaza amagciwane abangela izifo ezithwalwa yizilwane (VBDs).
Hausa: Abubuwan muhalli na waje suna yin tasiri ga yanayin sifashiyo-temforal na ƙwayoyin halitta da yawa, gami da ƙwarin da suke yaɗa ƙwayoyin cuta da suke da alhakin cututtukan ƙwari suke yaɗawa (VBDs).
Northern Sotho: Mabaka a tikologo ya ka ntle a huetša diphaphano tša sekgoba tša lebakanyana tša diphedi tše ntši, go akaretšwa dikhunkhwane tšeo di fetišago dipaktheria tšeo di bakago malwetši a go fetetšwa ke difetetši (di-VBDs).
Amharic: ውጫዊ የአካባቢ ሁኔታዎች በቬክተር ለሚተላለፉ በሽታዎች (ቬ.የ.በ) ተጠያቂ የሆኑትን በሽታ አምጪ ተህዋስያንን የሚያስተላልፉትን ነፍሳት ጨምሮ የብዙ ፍጥረታት የቦታ-እና የጊዜ ተለዋዋጭነት ላይ ተጽእኖ ያሳድራሉ።

English: Temperature is an especially important constraint on the fitness of a wide variety of insects, as they are primarily ectotherms.
Luganda: Ebbugumu nsonga nkulu mu busobozi bw’ebiwuka eby’enjawulo, olw’okuba ng’okusinga bye byekolera ebbugumu lyabyo.
Yoruba: Òté tí ó ṣe pàtàkì gidi gan-an ni ìgbónágbooru nínú ìdágágá ara onírúnrú àwọn kòkòrò, bí ó ṣe jẹ́ pé ẹ̀dá abẹ̀jẹ̀tútù ni wọ́n.
Zulu: Izinga lokushisa liwumkhawulo obaluleke kakhulu wokuqina kwezinhlobonhlobo zezinambuzane, njengoba ngokuyinhloko zingama-ectotherm.
Hausa: Yanayin jiki abu ne mai mahimmanci musamman wajen taƙaita kuzari na nau’o’in ƙwari iri-iri, kamar yadda suke da farko masu sauyin yanayi.
Northern Sotho: Thempheretršha ke bothata bjo bohlokwa bja mabapi le go itekanela ga mehutahuta ye mentši ya dikhunkhwane, ka ge ka tlhago di le tša madi a go tonya.
Amharic: በዋነኝነት ኤክቶተርሞች በመሆናቸው፣ በጣም ለብዙ የነፍሳት አይነቶች የአካል ብቃት የሙቀት መጠን በጣም ወሳኝ ገደብ ነው።

English: Temperature constrains the distribution of ectotherms and therefore of the infections that they spread in both space and time.
Luganda: Ebbugumu likugira okusaasaana kw’ebiwuka ebyekolera ebbugumu awamu n’endwadde ze bisaasaanya mu bifo n’obudde obw’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Ìgbónágboorú a máa ṣèdíwọ́ pípín àwọn ẹ̀dá abẹ̀jẹ̀tútù àti pé nípa bẹ́ẹ̀ a ṣèdíwọ́ ìkóràn tí wọ́n ń tànká ní ààyè àti ìgbà.
Zulu: Izinga lokushisa livimbela ukusatshalaliswa kwama-ectotherm ngakho-ke nezifo ezisakazwa endaweni kanye nesikhathi.
Hausa: Yanayin jiki yana taƙaita rarraba masu sauyin yanayi, don haka cututtukan da suke yaɗawa a sarari da kuma lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Thempheretšha e šitiša go phatlalatšwa ga diphedi tša madi a go tonya gomme ka go diphetetšo tšeo di phatlalalago bobedi sekgobeng le ka nako.
Amharic: የሙቀት መጠን የኤክቶተርሞችን መስፋፋት ይገድባል፤ እንዲሁም በዚህ ምክንያት በሁለቱም በቦታ እና በጊዜ የሚያሰራጯቸው ኢንፌክሽኖችም ላይ ተጽእኖ ያደርጋል።

English: More concretely, a mechanistic understanding of how temperature impacts traits of ectotherms to predict the distribution of ectotherms and vector-borne infections is key to predicting the consequences of climate change on transmission of VBDs like malaria.
Luganda: Okwongera okukikkaatiriza, okutegeera engeri ebbugumu gye likosaamu enneeyisa y’ebiwuka ebyekolera ebbugumu okusobola okuteebereza ensaasaana y’ebiwuka ebyekolera ebbugumu n’endwadde ezireetebwa obuwuka kikulu nnyo mu kuteebereza ebyo ebituusibwa obutonde bw’ensi ku kusaasaana kw’endwadde ezireetebwa VBDs ng’omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Èyí tí ó ṣeé fúnka mọ́ jù, lílo ẹ̀rọ fi lóye bí ìgbóná-gbooru ṣe nipa lórí àwòmọ́ àwọn ẹ̀dá abẹ̀jẹ̀tútù láti ṣe àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ bí àwọn ẹ̀dá abẹ̀jẹ̀tútù àti ìkóràn nípaṣe ìgénijẹ ṣe ń fọ́nká ṣe kókó sí ṣíṣe àsọtẹ́lè èsì àyípadà ojú-ọjọ́ nínú ìtànkálẹ̀ àwọn VBD bíi ibà.
Zulu: Ngokuphathekayo, ukuqonda kwemishini kokuthi izinga lokushisa lizithinta kanjani izici ze-ectotherm ukubikezela ukusatshalaliswa kwama-ectotherms kanye nezifo ezithwalwa yi-vector kuyisihluthulelo sokubikezela imiphumela yokushintsha kwesimo sezulu ekudluliseni ama-VBD afana nomalaleveva.
Hausa: A gaskiya, fahimtar injina na yadda zafin jiki yake tasiri halayen masu sauyin yanayi don hasashen rarraba ƙwari da yanayin jikinsu yake sauyawa da cututtukan da suke haifar da ƙwayoyin cuta shi ne mabuɗin hasashen sakamakon sauyin yanayi a kan watsa VBDs kamar cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao go bonagalago kudu, kwešišo ya metšhene ya mabapi le ka fao thempheretšha e amago mokgwa wa go phela wa diphedi tša madi a go tonya go akanya go phatlalatšwa ga diphedi tša madi a go tonya le diphetetšo tša go bakwa ke difetetši ke selo se bohlokwa sa go akanya dopielo tša phetogo ya tlelaemete go phetetšo ya di-VBD tša go swana le malaria.
Amharic: የበለጠ ተጨባጭ በሆነ መልኩ የሙቀት መጠን የኤክቶተርሞችን ባህሪያት እና የኤክቶተርሞችን እና በቬክተር የሚተላለፉ ኢንፌክሽኖች ስርጭት ላይ ያለውን ተጽእኖ መረዳት፣ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ እነደ ወባ ያሉ ቬ.የ.በዎችን ማስተላለፍ ላይ ያለውን መዘዝ ለመረዳት ቁልፍ ነገር ነው።

English: However, the response of transmission to temperature and other drivers is complex, as thermal traits of ectotherms are typically non-linear, and they interact to determine transmission constraints.
Luganda: Wabula, engeri ensaasaana gy’ekosebwamu ebbugumu n’ensonga endala si nnyangu, kubanga enneeyisa y’ebbugumu mu biwuka ebyekolera ebbugumu ekyukakyuka, era ekolagana okusobola okusalawo ensaasaana.
Yoruba: However, ìfèsì sí ìtànkálẹ̀ àrùn sí ìgbónágbooru àti àwọn alátilẹ̀yìn mìíràn rújú gan-an, bí ipa ààtò àwòmọ́ ooru lára àwọn ẹ̀dá abẹ̀jẹ̀tútù ṣe jẹ́ ségesège, àti bí wọ́n ṣe ń bára ṣe láti láti darí àwọn òté ìtànkálẹ̀.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, impendulo yokudluliselwa kumazinga okushisa nezinye izishayeli iyinkimbinkimbi, njengoba izici ezishisayo zama-ectotherms ngokuvamile azinamugqa, futhi ziyasebenzisana ukuze zinqume izithiyo zokudlulisela.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, amsawar watsawa zuwa zafin jiki da sauran masu haifarwa yana da rikitarwa, saboda yanayin zafi na masu sauyin yanayi yawanci ba mai alaƙa ba ne, kuma suna hulɗa ne don sanin iyakokin watsawa.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, phetolo ya phetetšo go thempheretšha le dibaki tše dingwe e hlakahlakane, ka ge lephelo la diphedi tša madi a go tonya phišong ka tlwaelo le se la thwii, ebile di a dirišana go tseba mathata a phetetšo.
Amharic: ነገር ግን መተላለፍ ለሙቀት መጠን እና ለሌሎች ነጂዎች ያለው ምላሽ ውስብስብ ነው። የዚህም ምክንያቱ የኤክቶተርሞች የሙቀት ባህሪያት አንድ ወጥ አለመሆኑ ነው፤ እንዲሁም ሌሎች የመተላለፍ ገደቦችን ለመወሰን መስተጋብር ያደርጋሉ።

English: In this study, we assess and compare the effect of temperature on the transmission of two malaria parasites, Plasmodium falciparum and Plasmodium vivax, by two malaria vector species, Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles stephensi.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, twekenneenya era ne tugeraageranya engeri ebbugumu gye likosaamu okusaasaana kw’obuwuka bw’omusujja gw’ensiri bubiri, Plasmodium falciparum ne Plasmodium vivax, obutambuzibwa ebika by’ensiri bibiri, Anopheles gambiae ne Anopheles stephensi.
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, a ṣe àyẹ̀wò àti àfiwé ipa ìgbóná-gbooru lórí ìtànkálẹ̀ àfòmọ́ ibà méjì, Àfòmọ́ ibà abo ẹ̀fọn àti àfòmọ́ ibà ìgbóná, láti ara àwọn ẹ̀yà ẹ̀fọn ibà mẹ́jì, Anopheles gambiae àti Anopheles stephensi.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, sihlola futhi siqhathanise umthelela wezinga lokushisa ekudluliseni izimuncagazi ezimbili zikamalaleveva, i-Plasmodium falciparum ne-Plasmodium vivax, ngezinhlobo ezimbili ezithwala umalaleveva, i-Anopheles gambiae ne-Anopheles stephensi.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, mun tantance tare da kuma kwatanta tasirin zafin jiki a kan watsa ƙwayoyin cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro guda biyu, wato Plasmodium falciparum da kuma Plasmodium vivax, ta nau’in cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro guda biyu, wato Anopheles gambiae da kuma Anopheles stephensi.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišiong tše, re a sekaseka le go bapetša seabe sa thempheretšha go go phetetšo ya dipharasaete tše pedi tša malaria, Plasmodium falciparum le Plasmodium vivax, e lego mehuta ye mebedi ya diphedi tša dilomi tša go baka malaria, Anopheles gambiae le Anopheles stephensi.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት የሙቀት መጠን በሁለት የወባ ጥገኛ ተህዋስያን፣ ፕላስሞዲየም ፋልሲፓረም እና ፕላስሞዲየም ቫይቫክስ በሁለት የወባ የቬክተር ዝርያዎች አኖፊለስ ጋምቢ እና አኖፊለስ ስቴፈንሲ መተላለፍ ላይ ያለውን ተጽእኖ እናስሳለን።

English: We model the non-linear responses of temperature dependent mosquito and parasite traits (mosquito development rate, bite rate, fecundity, egg to adult survival, vector competence, mortality rate, and parasite development rate) and incorporate these traits into a suitability metric based on a model for the basic reproductive number across temperatures.
Luganda: Tutekenkanya enneeyisa ezikyukakyuka ez’obubonero bw’ensiri n’obuwuka obwesigamiziddwa ku bbugumu (enkulaakulana y’ensiri, ennuma, obuzaazi, okubeerawo kw’amagi, obukozi bw’akawuka, okufa, n’enkulaakulana y’akawuka) ne tuteeka obubonero buno mu kibalo ky’obusaanyizi ekyesigamiziddwa ku mutetenkanyirizo ogw’omuwendo gw’okuzaala ogusookerwako mu bbugumu lyonna.
Yoruba: A ṣàwòṣe èsì ààto ségesège àwọn ẹ̀fọn tí wọ́n gbára lè ìgbóná-gbooru àti àwòmọ́ àfòmọ́ (ìwọ̀n ìdàgbàsókè ẹ̀fọn, ìwọ̀n ìgénijẹ, ìsabíamọ́, ìṣẹ̀mí láti ẹ̀yin di àgbà, àti ìwọ̀n ìdàgbàsókè àfòmọ́) kí a sì sàfikún àwọn àwọ̀mọ́ wọ̀nyí sínú ìwọ̀n tí ó dára tí ó dá lórí àwòṣe fún iye ajẹmọ́-ìbí kári gbogbo ìgbóná-gbooru.
Zulu: Senza imodeli yokusabela okungeyona imigqa yomiyane oncike kuzinga lokushisa kanye nezici ze-parasite (izinga lokukhula komiyane, izinga lokulunywa, i-fecundity, iqanda lokusinda komuntu omdala, amandla e-vector, izinga lokufa, kanye nezinga lokukhula kwe-parasite) futhi sihlanganise lezi zimpawu kumethrikhi yokufaneleka esekelwe imodeli yenombolo eyisisekelo yokuzala kuwo wonke amazinga okushisa.
Hausa: Muna ƙididdige amsoshin da ba masu alaƙa ba na sauro masu dogaro da zafin jiki da halayen kaska (yawan ci gaban sauro da yawan cizo da haihuwa da ƙwai zuwa rayuwar babba da ƙwarewar mai yaɗa cuta da yawan mace-mace da yawan ci gaban kaska) kuma mun haɗa adadin haihuwa a yanayin zafi.
Northern Sotho: Re lekola diphetolko tše di sego tša thwii tša menang ye e botilego thempheretšha le lephelo la dipharasaete (kelo ya go hlamego ga menang, kelo ya go loma, bokgoni bja go ikoketša, mae go fihla e le tše kgolo di iphediša, go kgona ga dilomi go ikoketša, kelo ya go hwa ga tšona, le kelo ya go hlamega ga dipharasaete) le go tsenya mekgwa ye ya tšona ka go kelo go mokgwa wa go ela palo ya go ikoketša ga tšona go ralala le dithempheretšha.
Amharic: በሙቀት መጠን ላይ የሚተማመኑ የወባ ትንኝ እና የጥገኛ ተህዋስ ባህሪያት (የወባ የመራቢያ ምጥነት፣ እርግዝና፣ ከእንቁላል ወደ አዋቂነት የመዳን መጠን፣ የቬክተር ብቃት፣ የሞት ምጥነት እና የጥገኛ ተህዋስ የመራቢያ ምጥነት) አንድ ወጥ ያልሆኑ ምላሾችን ሞዴል እናደርጋለን። እነዚህንም ባህሪያት በተለያዩ የሙቀት መጠኖች በመሰረታዊ የመራቢያ ቁጥር ተስማሚ መለኪያ ላይ በተመሰረተ ሞዴል እናካትታለን።

English: Our model predicts that the optimum temperature for transmission suitability is similar for the four mosquito-parasite combinations assessed in this study.
Luganda: Omutetenkanyirizo gwaffe guteebereza nti ebbugumu erisaanidde mu busaanyizi bw’okusaasaanya lifaanana mu bika by’obuwuka ebina ebyekenneenyezebwa mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Yoruba: Àwòṣe wa ṣe àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ pé ìgbóná-gbooru tí ó ga jù fún ìtànkálẹ̀ jọra fún àwọn àfòmọ́-ẹ̀fọn mẹ́rẹ̀ẹ̀rin tí a ṣàyẹ̀wò nínú ìwádìí yìí.
Zulu: Imodeli yethu ibikezela ukuthi izinga lokushisa eliphezulu lokufaneleka kokudluliselwa lifana nezinhlanganisela ezine ze-mosquito-parasite ezihlolwe kulolu cwaningo.
Hausa: Samfurinmu ya yi hasashen cewa mafi kyawun zafin jiki don dacewa da watsawa ya yi kama da haɗuwar sauro-kaska guda huɗu da aka tantance a cikin wannan binciken.
Northern Sotho: Mokgwa wa rena wa kelo o akanya gore dithempheretšha tša godimo tša go kgontšha phetetšo di a swana go dikopanyo tša pharasaete ya menang tšeo di sekasekilwego ka mo dinyakišišong.
Amharic: ሞዴላችን ለመተላለፍ ተስማሚ የሆነውን ምርጥ የሙቀት መጠን ይተነብያል ይህም በዚህ ጥናት ለተዳሰሱት አራቱ-የወባ ትንኝ ጥገኛ ተህዋስ ጥምረቶች አንድ አይነት ነው።

English: The main differences are found at the thermal limits.

Zulu: Umehluko omkhulu utholakala emikhawulweni yokushisa.
Hausa: Ana samun babban bambanci a iyakar ɗumi.
Northern Sotho: Diphapano tše kgolo di hwetšwa ka go mellwane ya dithempheretšha.
Amharic: ዋናዎቹ ልዩነቶች በሙቀት ገደቦች ላይ ይገኛሉ።

English: More specifically, we found significant differences in the upper thermal limit between parasites spread by the same mosquito (An. stephensi) and between mosquitoes carrying P. falciparum.
Luganda: Okusingira ddala, twasanga enjawulo ez’amaanyi mu kkomo ly’ebbugumu erya waggulu wakati w’obuwuka obusaasaanyizibwa ensiri ey’ekika ekimu (An. stephensi) ne wakati w’ensiri ezitambuza P. falciparum.
Yoruba: Ní pàtó, a rí ìyàtọ̀ tí ó ṣe kókó nínú ìwọ̀n ooru tí ó ga láàrin àwọn àfòmọ́ tí oríṣìí ẹ̀fọn kan (An. stephensi) ń tàn ká àti àwọn ẹ̀fọn tí wọ́n ní àfòmọ́ ibà abo ẹ̀fọn.
Zulu: Ngokuqondile, sithole umehluko omkhulu emkhawulweni wokushisa ongaphezulu phakathi kwezimuncagazi ezisakazwa umiyane ofanayo (An. stephensi) naphakathi komiyane abathwele i-P. falciparum.
Hausa: Musamman ma, mun sami bambance-bambance masu yawa a cikin iyakar ɗumi na sama a tsakanin kaskoki da sauro guda (An.stephensi) yake yaɗawa da kuma a tsakanin sauraye masu ɗauke da P. Falciparum.
Northern Sotho: Gabotse kudu, re hweditše diphapano tše dikgolo ka mollwane wa thempheretšha wa ka godimo magareng ga dipharasaete tšeo di phatlalatšwago ke monang wo o swanago (An. stephensi) le magareng ga menang ye e rwelego P. falciparum.
Amharic: በተለይ በተመሳሳይ የወባ ትንኝ (አኖ. ስቴፈንሲ) እና ፕ. ፋልሲፓረምን በሚይዙ የወባ ትንኞች መካከል በሚሰራጩ ጥገኛ ተህዋስያን መካከል በላይኛው የሙቀት ገደብ ላይ ጉልህ የሆኑ ልዩነቶችን አግኝተናል።

English: In contrast, at the lower thermal limit the significant differences were primarily between the mosquito species that both carried the same pathogen (e.g., An. stephensi and An. gambiae both with P. falciparum).
Luganda: Okwawukanako n’ekyo, ku kkomo ly’ebbugumu erya wansi enjawulo ez’amaanyi zaali okusinga wakati w’ebika by’ensiri ezaatambuzanga ekika ky’akawuka ekimu (okugeza An. stephensi ne An. gambiae wamu ne P. falciparum).
Yoruba: Ní àwòfín, ní ìwọ̀n ooru tí ó rọlẹ̀, àwọn ìyàtọ̀ tí ó ṣe kókó náà wà láàrin ẹ̀yà àwọn ẹ̀fọn tí wọ́n jọ ní àfàìsàn kannáà (b.a., An. stephensi àti An. Gambiae àwọn méjèèjì pẹ̀lú àfòmọ́ ibà abo ẹ̀fọn).
Zulu: Ngokuphambene, emkhawulweni wokushisa ophansi umehluko obalulekile wawuphakathi kwezinhlobo zomiyane zombili ezithwele i-pathogen efanayo (isb., i-An. stephensi kanye ne-An. gambiae zombili ezine-P. falciparum).
Hausa: Akasin haka, a iyakar ɗumi na ƙasa muhimman bambance-bambance sun kasance da farko a tsakanin nau’in sauro waɗanda dukkansu suke ɗauke da ƙwayoyin cuta guda ɗaya (misali, An. stephensi da kuma An. gambiae duka tare da P. falciparum).
Northern Sotho: Go fapana le se, ka mollwaneng wa thempheretšha ya fase diphapano tše kgolo di bile kudu magareng ga mehuta ya menang ya gore bobedi e rwala dipaktheria (go fa mohlala, An. stephensi le An. gambiae bobedi di na le P. falciparum).
Amharic: በተቃራኒው በዝቅተኛው የሙቀት ገደብ ወሳኞቹ ልዩነቶች በዋነኝነት አንድ አይነት በሽታ አምጪ ተህዋስያንን በያዙት በሁለቱም የወባ ትንኝ ዝርያዎች ላይ ነበር (ምሳሌ፤ አኖ. ስቴፈንሲ እና አኖ. ጋምቢ ሁለቱም ፕ. ፋልሲፓረምን ይዘው ነበር)።

English: Using prevalence data from Africa and Asia, we show that the transmission suitability metric S(T) calculated from our mechanistic model is an important predictor of malaria prevalence.
Luganda: Nga tukozesa ebikwata ku miwendo gy’abalwadde okuva mu Africa ne Asia, tulaga nti ekibalo ky’obusaanyizi ekyabalibwa okuva mu mutetenkanyirizo gwaffe kikulu nnyo mu kuteebereza abalwala omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Nípa lílo ìwọ́pọ̀ dátà láti Áfíríkà àÉṣíà, a ṣàfihàn rẹ̀ pé ìṣirò ìwọ̀n ìtànkálè tí a ṣe láti ara àwòṣe onímọ̀-ẹ̀rọ wa jẹ́ aṣàsọtẹ́lẹ̀ tí ó ṣe pàtàkì fún mímọ ìwọ́pọ̀ ibà.
Zulu: Sisebenzisa idatha yokusabalala evela e-Afrika nase-Asia, sibonisa ukuthi i-metric yokufaneleka kokudlulisela i-S(T) ebalwa kusukela kumodeli yethu yemishini iyisibikezelo esibalulekile sokudlanga kukamalaleveva.
Hausa: Ta yin amfani da ɗimbin bayanai daga Afirka da kuma Asiya, muna nuna cewa ma’auni S(T) na dacewa da watsawa da aka ƙididdige su daga samurin injinmu shi ne muhimmin abin hasashen yawaitar cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomiša tshedimošo ya go tlala ga tšona ka Afrika le ka Asia, re bontšha gore kelo S(T) go ba maleba ga phetetšo yeo e hlakantšwego go tšwa go mokgwa wa rena wa metšhene ke seakanyi se bohlokwa sa go tlala ga malaria.

Hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin dalilan da masana kimiyya suke son su gane a wane yanayi ne sauraye suke bunƙasa shi ne don su iya hasashen yadda sauyin yanayi zai yi illa ga yaɗuwar zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Le lengwe la lebaka leo bašomi ba tša mahlale ba nyakago go kwešiša gore menang e kgona go phela gabotse ka dithempheretšha dife ke gore ba kgone go akanya ka fao phetogo ya tlelaemete e ka amago go phatlalatšwa ga malaria.
Amharic: ሳይንቲስቶች በየትኞቹ የሙቀት መጠኖች የወባ ትንኞች በደንብ እንደሚያድጉ ለመረዳት የሚፈልጉበት አንዱ ምክንያት የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ እንዴት የወባ መስፋፋት ላይ ተጽእኖ እንደሚያደርስ ለመተንበይ እንዲችሉ ነው።

English: In this study, researchers looked at how temperature affected the spread of two malaria parasites (Plasmodium falciparum and Plasmodium vivax) by two mosquitoes (Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles stephensi).
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baatunuulira engeri ebbugumu gye likosaamu ensaasaana y’obuwuka bw’omusujja gw’ensiri (Plasmodium falciparum ne Plasmodium vivax) nga kikolebwa ensiri bbiri (Anopheles gambiae ne Anopheles stephensi).
Yoruba: Nínú ìwádìí yìí, àwọn asèwádìí wo bí ìgbóná-gbooru ṣe ń nipa lórí ìtànká oríṣìí àfòmọ́ ibà méjì (Àfòmọ́ ibà abo ẹ̀fọn àti àfòmọ́ ibà ìgbóná) láti ara ẹ̀fọn méjì (Anopheles gambiae àti Anopheles stephensi).
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babheke ukuthi izinga lokushisa likuthinte kanjani ukusabalala kwezinambuzane ezimbili zikamalaleveva (i-Plasmodium falciparum ne-Plasmodium vivax) omiyane ababili (i-Anopheles gambiae ne-Anopheles stephensi).
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun duba yadda yanayin jiki ya shafi yaɗuwar cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro guda biyu (Plasmodium falciparum da kuma Plasmodium vivax) ta hanyar sauraye guda biyu (Anopheles gambiae da Anopheles stephensi).
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba ile ba lebelela ka fao thempheretšha e amilego go phatlalatšwa ga dipharasaete tša malaria tše pedi (e lego Plasmodium falciparum le Plasmodium vivax) ke menang ye mebedi (e lego Anopheles gambiae le Anopheles stephensi).
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች ሁለት የወባ ጥገኛ ተህዋስያን (ፕላስሞዲየም ፋልሲፓረም እና ፕላስሞዲየም ቫይቫክስ) በሁለት የወባ ትንኞች (አኖፊለስ ጋምቢ እና አኖፊለስ ስቴፈንሲ) መሰራጨት ላይ የሙቀት መጠን ያለውን ተጽእኖ ዳስሰዋል።

English: Based on information collected from Africa and Asia, the researchers used computer models to predict how temperature affected the development of both the mosquitos and the parasites, as well as specific mosquito traits like biting, reproduction, survival and death.
Luganda: Nga beesigama ku bubaka obwakuŋŋaanyizibwa okuva mu Africa ne Asia, abanoonyereza baakozesa emitetenkanyirizo gya kompyuta okuteebereza engeri ebbugumu gye lyakosaamu enkulaakulana y’ensiri zombi awamu n’obuwuka, awamu n’ebikwata ku nsiri ng’okuluma, okuzaala, okuwangaala n’okufa.
Yoruba: Lórí àlàyé tí wọ́n gbà láti Áfíríkà àti Éṣíà, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ṣàmúlò àwọn àwòṣe kọ̀mpútà láti ṣe àsọtẹ́lè nípa bí ìgbóná-gbooru ṣe ń nípa lọ́rí ìdàgbàsókè àwọn ẹ̀fọn àti àfòmọ́, àti àwọn ìṣe ẹ̀fọn kọ̀ọ̀kan ní pàtó bí gígéjẹ, bíbísíi, ìṣẹ̀mí àti ikú.
Zulu: Ngokusekelwe olwazini oluqoqwe e-Afrika nase-Asia, abacwaningi basebenzisa amamodeli wekhompiyutha ukuze babikezele ukuthi izinga lokushisa lithinte kanjani ukuthuthukiswa komiyane nama-parasites, kanye nezici ezithile zomiyane njengokuluma, ukuzala, ukusinda nokufa.
Hausa: Dangane da bayanan da aka tattara daga Afirka da kuma Asiya, masu binciken sun yi amfani da samfurorin kwamfuta don yin hasashen yadda yanayin jiki ya shafi ci gaban sauro da ƙwayoyin cuta, da kuma takamaiman halayen sauro kamar cizo da haihuwa da rayuwa da kuma mutuwa.
Northern Sotho: Go ya ka tshedimošo yeo e kgobokeditšwego ka Afrika le ka Asia, banyakišiši ba šomišitše mekgwa ya dikhomphutha go akanya ka fao thempoheretšha e amilego bobedi go hlamega ga bobedi menang le dipharasaete, gammogo le lephelo le itšego la menang go swana le go loma, go tswala, go phela le lehu.
Amharic: ከአፍሪካ እና ከእስያ የተሰበሰቡ መረጃዎች ላይ በመመስረት ተመራማሪዎቹ የኮምፒውተር ሞዴሎችን በመጠቀም የሙቀት መጠን የወባ ትንኞች እና ጥገኛ ተህዋስያን መራባት ላይ ያለውን ተጽእኖ እንዲሁም የተወሰኑ እንደ መናከስ፣ መራባት፣ በህይወት መቆየት እና መሞት የመሰሉ የወባ ትንኝ ባህሪያትን ሰብስበዋል።

English: They then determined the best temperature for reproduction of both the mosquitoes and parasites.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma baazuula ebbugumu erisinga okusobozesa okuzaala mu nsiri n’obuwuka.
Yoruba: Wọ́n wá ṣe ìpinnu ìgbóná-gboorú tí ó dára jùlọ fún àwọn ẹ̀fọn àti àfòmọ́ náà lahti máa bí síi.
Zulu: Babe sebenquma izinga lokushisa elingcono kakhulu lokuzala kokubili omiyane nama-parasite.
Hausa: Daga nan, sai suka tantance mafi kyawun yanayin jiki don haihuwa na sauraye da kuma ƙwayoyin cuta.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ile ba lekola thempheretšha ye kaone ya go kgona go tswala ga bobedi menang le dipharasaete.
Amharic: በመቀጠል ለሁለቱም የወባ ትንኞች እና ጥገኛ ተህዋስያን መራባት ምርጥ የሆነውን የሙቀት መጠን ለይተው አውጥተዋል።

English: The researchers reported that the two mosquitoes survived at similar temperatures, but ideal temperatures for spreading the parasites differed.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baalaga nti ensiri zombi ziwangaalira mu bbugumu lyerimu, naye ebbugumu erisinga obulungi okutambulizaamu obuwuka lyali lyawuka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà jábọ̀ pé àwọn ẹ̀fọn méjèèjì yè nínú ìwọ̀n ìgbóná-gbooru kannáà, àmọ́ ìgbóná-gboorú tí ó dára jùlọ láti tan àfòmọ́ náà ká yàtọ̀.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babike ukuthi omiyane ababili basinda emazingeni okushisa afanayo, kodwa amazinga okushisa afanelekile okusabalalisa izimuncagazi ayehluka.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ruwaito cewa sauraye biyu sun rayu a yanayin jikiiri ɗaya, amma yanayin jiki da ya dace don yaɗa ƙwayoyin cutar ya bambanta.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba begile gore menang ye ka bobedi e kgonne go phela ka go dithempheretšha tša go swana , eupša dithempheretšha tše di tlwaelegilego tša go kgona go phatlalatša ga dipharasaete di ile tša fapana.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደዘገቡት ሁለት የወባ ትንኞች በተመሳሳይ የሙቀት መጠን በህይወት መቆየት የቻሉ ሲሆን ጥገኛ ተህዋስያንን ለማሰራጨት ግን እጅግ ተስማሚ የሆነው የሙቀት መጠን ይለያይ ነበር።

English: An. stephensi mosquito spread parasites between 15◦C and 37◦C, while An. stephensi, did so between 19◦C and 32◦C.
Luganda: Ensiri za An. stephensi zitambuliza obuwuka mu bbugumu eriri wakati wa 15◦C ne 37◦C, so nga An. stephensi, zitambuliza mu bbugumu eriri wakati wa 19◦C ne 32◦C.
Yoruba: Àwọn ẹ̀fọn An. stephensi máa tan àfòmọ́ kálẹ̀ láàrin 15◦C àti 37◦C, nígbà tí An. stephensi máa ń ṣe èyí ní 19◦C àti 32◦C.
Zulu: I-An umiyane we-stenthensi usakaza izimuncagazi phakathi kuka-15◦C no-37◦C, kuyilapho i-An stephensi, wenze njalo phakathi kuka-19◦C no-32◦C.
Hausa: Sauron An. stephensi yana yaɗa ƙwayoyin cuta tsakanin 15◦C zuwa 37◦C, a yayin da An. stephensi, ya yi haka tsakanin 19◦C zuwa 32◦C.
Northern Sotho: Monang wa An. stephensi o phatlalatša dipharasaete ka dithempheretšha tša magareng ga 15◦C le 37◦C, mola e le gore An. Gambiae, e kgona go dira seo ka dithempheretšha tša magareng ga 19◦C le 32◦C.
Amharic: አኖ.የስቴፈንሲ የወባ ትንኝ ጥገኛ ተህዋስያንን በ15◦ሴ እና በ37◦ሴ መካከል የሚያስተላልፍ ሲሆን አኖ.ስቴፈንሲ በ19◦ሴ እና በ32◦ሴ መካከል አስተላልፏል።

English: The researchers said their results meant that transmission of malaria in most countries in Africa was mainly through An.stephensi and not An. Gambiae.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti bye baazuula byali bitegeeza nti okusaasaana kw’omusujja gw’ensiri mu mawanga ga Afrika agasinga kwali kwa kuyita mu An.stephensi so si An. Gambiae.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àwọn èsì wọn túmọ̀ sí pé ìtànkálẹ̀ ibà ní ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ orílẹ̀-èdè ní Áfíríkà ló ti ara An. stephensi wa, kì í ṣe láti ara An. gambiae.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe imiphumela yabo isho ukuthi ukusuleleka kukamalaleveva emazweni amaningi e-Afrika ikakhulukazi nge-An.stephensi hhayi i-An. I-gambiae
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sakamakon nasu ya nuna cewa watsa cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro a yawancin ƙasashen Afirka ta fi ta hanyar An. stephensi ne ba An. Gambia ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dipoelo tša bona di bolela gore phetetšo ya malaria ka dinageng tše ntši ka Afrika e bile kudu ka lebaka la An. stephensi e sego ka An. Gambiae.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳሉት ውጤቶቻቸው የሚጠቁሙት በአፍሪካ ባሉ አብዛኛዎቹ ሃገራት የወባ መተላለፍ በዋነኝነት የተከሰተው በአኖ. ስቴፈንሲ ነው እንጂ በ አኖ.ጋምቢ አልነበረም።

English: It was however interesting to note that other studies had reported that An. gambiae caused most malaria cases in Africa.
Luganda: Wabula kyali kinyuma okulaba nti okunoonyereza okulala kwali kulaze nti An. gambiae ye yali esinga okusaasaanya omusujja gw’ensiri mu Afrika.
Yoruba: Ó múni lọ́kàn jọjọ láti mọ̀ pé àwọn ìwádìí mìíràn ti sọ tẹ́lè pé An. gambie ni ó ń ṣòkùnfà ọ̀pọ̀ ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ibà ní Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Kwakujabulisa nokho ukuqaphela ukuthi ezinye izifundo zazibike ukuthi u-An. i-gambiae ibangele izigameko eziningi zikamalaleveva e-Afrika.
Hausa: Duk da haka, yana da ban sha'awa a lura cewa wasu binciken sun ruwaito cewa An. gambiae ya fi haifar da mafi yawan masu kamuwa da cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go l;e bjale go be go kgahliša go lemoga gore dinyakišišo tše dingwe di begile gore An. gambiae e bakile malwetši a mantši a malaria ka Afrika.
Amharic: ነገር ግን የሚገረመው ነገር ሌሎች ጥናቶች እንደዘገቡት አኖ.ጋምቢ በአፍሪካ አብዛኛዎቹን የወባ ኬዞች አስከስቷል።

English: The researchers were able to identify and map risk areas more suitable for malaria transmission all year round.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baasobola okuzuula n’okugeraageranya ebifo eby’obulabe ebisinga okusobozesa okusaasaana kw’omusujja gw’ensiri mu mwaka gwonna.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà ráàyè tọ́ka sí ya ìlapa àwọn ààyè tí wọ́n lè fààyè gba ìtànkálẹ̀ ibà yípo ọdún.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bakwazi ukuhlonza nokubeka imephu izindawo ezisengozini ezilungele ukudluliswa kukamalaleveva unyaka wonke.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun sami damar ganowa da kuma zana taswirar wuraren haɗarin da suka fi dacewa da watsa cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro a duk shekara.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ile ba kgona go tseba le go lekola mafelo a kotsi ao a loketšego kudu phetetšo ya malaria ngwaga ka moka.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ አመቱን ሙሉ ለወባ መተላለፍ ምቹ የሆኑትን የአደጋ አካባቢዎች ለማወቅ እና ለይተው ለማውጣት ችለዋል።

English: They said An.gambiae and An. stephensi mosquitoes survived best in places around Africa and Asia.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ensiri za An.gambiae ne An. stephensi zaali zisinga kuwangaalira mu bitundu by’omu Afirika ne Asia.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àwọn ẹ̀fọn An.gambiae àti An. Stephensi a máa yè dáadáa ní àwọn àyíká Áfíríkà àti Éṣíà.
Zulu: Bathi u-An.gambiae no-An. omiyane be-stephen baphila kangcono ezindaweni ezizungeze i-Afrika ne-Asia.
Hausa: Suka ce saurayen An. gambiae An. stephensi sun fi rayuwa da kyau a wurare a kusa da Afirka da kuma Asiya.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore menang ya An.gambiae le An. stephensi e ile ya kgona go phela bokaone ka mafelong a ka Afrika le Asia.
Amharic: እንዳሉትም አኖ. ጋምቢ እና አኖ.ስቴፈንሲ የወባ ትንኞች በአፍሪካ እና በእስያ አካባቢዎች በተሻለ ሁኔታ በህይወት ለመቆየት ችለዋል።

English: The researchers also said An. stephensi originated from Asia but it was now in African countries such as Djibouti and Ethiopia.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baagamba nti An. stephensi yasibuka mu Asia naye nga kati eri mu mawanga ga Afirika nga Djibouti ne Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún sọ pé An. stephensi ti ilẹ̀ Éṣíà wà àmọ́ ó ti wà ní àwọn orílè-èdè Áfíríkà bíi Djibouti àti Ethiopia báyìí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bathi u-An. I-stephensi yadabuka e-Asia kodwa manje isisemazweni ase-Afrika anjenge-Djibouti ne-Ethiopia.
Hausa: Haka nan masu binciken sun kuma ce An. Stephensi ya samo asali ne daga Asiya amma yanzu yana cikin ƙasashen Afirka kamar Djibouti da kuma Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gape gore An. stephensi e tšwa ka Asia eupša bjale e ka dinageng tša Afrika tša go swana le Djibouti le Ethiopia.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ የወባ ጥገኛ ተህዋስያን የተሰራጩባቸውን ቅጦች መከተል እንደቻሉ ተናግረዋል፤ በእርግጥም የወባ ሸክምን መተንበይ ችለዋል።

English: The researchers said if they could follow patterns through which malaria parasites are spread, they could actually predict malaria burden.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti singa baali basobola okulondoola engeri obuwuka bw’omusujja gw’ensiri gye busaasaanyizibwamu, bandibadde basobola okuteebereza ekizibu ky’omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé bí wọ́n bá lè tẹ̀lé ìhun tí àfòmọ́ ibà ń gbà tànká, wọ́n yóò lè àsọtẹ́lẹ̀ àjàgà ibà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi uma bekwazi ukulandela amaphethini okusakazeka ngawo amagciwane kamalaleveva, empeleni bangabikezela umthwalo we-malaria.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce idan za su iya bin tsarin da ake yaɗa ƙwayoyin cutar zazzaɓin cizon sauro, za su iya hasashen nauyin zazzaɓin cizon sauro.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore ge ba ka kgona go latela mekgwa yeo ka yona dipharasaete tša malaria di phatlalatšwago ka yona, ba ka kgona go akanya morwalo wa malaria.
